# University of Twente Research Information

> A comprehensive research portal showcasing University of Twente's expertise in ICT, biotechnology, and nanotechnology with accessible discovery tools for researcher profiles and collaborative research output.

This research information system serves as the central hub for discovering and exploring research initiatives at the University of Twente. The portal prioritizes both research discovery and accessibility compliance, making research data available to all users including those with disabilities.

## Key Topics

- University of Twente
- ICT
- biotechnology
- nanotechnology
- research-information
- researcher-profiles

## Research Portal

- [University of Twente Research Information](https://research.utwente.nl): Main research portal featuring ICT, biotechnology, and nanotechnology research with researcher profiles, research output discovery, and collaboration mapping tools.

## Support & Contact

- [Contact - University of Twente Research Information](https://research.utwente.nl/en/contact/index): Contact form and support resources for University of Twente Research Information portal users.

## Accessibility & Compliance

- [Accessibility statement for University of Twente Research Information](https://research.utwente.nl/en/web-accessibility): WCAG compliance documentation and accessibility statement detailing disability support, assistive technology compatibility (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver), and regulatory compliance with UK accessibility regulations.
